newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-LOCAL FIRMS RAISED $75 MLN IN Q1.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-LOCAL FIRMS RAISED $75 MLN IN Q1.

text.p: Lithuanian companies raised $75 million in new capital on foreign and local markets after raising $205 million in 1996, an investment and capital markets conference was told here on Thursday.
"Lithuanian companies managed to raise $205 million in new capital on local and foreign markets in 1996," Margarita Starkevichiute, a financial analyst with the depository, told the conference.
"In the first quarter of this year, that figure was $75 million," she said.
"The reason behind the success is the improving situation in industry," she said, noting that exports rose last year by 21.2 percent.
"It was the biggest growth figure in central and eastern Europe," she added.
She also said that it is a good time to buy Lithuanian stocks as many shareholders took their stakes through vouchers and are willing to sell cheaply and quickly.
